title: Design: Actions menu with Deactivate parts looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Press Escape.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The three-dot button shows a light grey square behind its dots while the menu is open.
  • The menu opens just below the three-dot button, its right edge lined up with the button, as a white card with a shadow.
  • It lists, top to bottom, in plain dark text with no icons: Cycle count, Deactivate parts, Export.
  • The menu covers the column headers under it; the blue New Inventory Part button stays fully visible.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes and the three-dot button loses its grey square.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R1: “Bulk deactivation is a mode. The user turns it on from the Inventory actions menu, the three-dot button in the toolbar that holds Cycle count and Export.”
  • S2-R2: “The menu entry reads "Deactivate parts" while the Active tab shows and "Activate parts" while the Inactive tab shows. Only one of the two shows at a time. It sits between Cycle count and Export.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "4.1 The actions menu". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bulk-01-p4-1-actions-menu.png

The design's own words:

  • “"Deactivate parts" sits between Cycle count and Export while the Active tab shows (S2-R1, S2-R2). A user without the Delete permission does not see it (S8-R3).”
